title: 第10章 理论第11章 下马威
content_zh:
二楼的食堂。
陈冲四个都累了一天，消耗极大。除了餐盘那点儿东西，都各自拿了至少一管营养膏。
先把正经食物吃完之后，营养膏就啃得慢了，正好可以交流。
李晓光佩服道
“陈冲，你学得是真快，完全不像之前没基础的。”
陈冲摇头
“在这儿，还不够快。”
几人都是沉默的点点头。
李晓光踌躇片刻，还是问道
“陈冲，方不方便请教一下，你的呼吸法到底是怎么练的啊？我以为你没基础，负担会很大，结果……一下就掌握了。”
王力和刘河涛也竖起了耳朵，但王力嘀咕道
“谁会给别人说自己练功的秘诀？哪有那么大方的人。”
但出乎他的意料，陈冲都没有考虑，讲起了自己发现的规律，呼吸法的韵律，以及记忆与练习诀窍。
三个人很快都听入迷了，连手上的东西都忘了吃。
“原来……原来还有这些门道。我一点都没发现。”
刘河涛讷讷道。
王力也恍然大悟，听到刘河涛的话又呵了一声
“你能发现就怪了。”
李晓光则听得连连点头，眼睛放光
“厉害了！我有点想法了，明天应该能入门！”

本来也挺高兴的王力一下不乐意了
“什么明天你就入门了……听一听你就会，吹牛逼吧。”
李晓光没理他，只是一脸诚恳的对陈冲道
“陈冲，谢了。我都没想到你会讲这么细，的确一般人不会分享自己的诀窍的。要不是于教练说呼吸法要尽快掌握，我也不想唐突，但没想到你格局是这个！”
他竖起了拇指。
刘河涛也连连点头
“陈冲是好人。”
“这就好人了……”
王力啧了一声，但也只是小声逼逼了一下，没多说。
陈冲呵道
“哪有那么夸张。只是咱们一起来的，本来就该要同舟共济。你们就是不问，明早练习的时候我也想给你们说的。”
他和三人现在是同舟共济，帮帮他们是举手之劳，也是抱团取暖；
再者，给他人讲解也是自己再学习的过程。
以前他就会在给同学讲题的过程中有新的收获，刚刚讲呼吸法果然又厘清了一些细节，自己对呼吸法的领悟也加深了。
几人兴奋的低声讨论起来，除了呼吸法又说起了搏击操，这倒是李晓光了解得要多些。
“虽然于教练说呼吸法是根本，但是没有搏击操针对性的锻炼，光靠呼吸法淬炼身体也会很慢。而且，没有搏击操的打法，就算身体素质提上来了，也只是空有蛮力。如果说呼吸法是一个流派的根本，搏击操就是主干。
“陈冲你进度快，搏击操可以多用心。我之前在前一个老师那上过体验课，那搏击操我感觉还不如于教练的。
“其实锻炼方法，除了呼吸法和配套的搏击操，还有药汤、药膏、药浴等等，是一整个系统。于教练肯定没给我们教全。”
content_en:
The cafeteria on the second floor.
All four of Chen Chong were tired after a long day and consumed a lot of energy. In addition to the things on the dinner plate, everyone took at least one tube of nutritional cream.
After finishing the serious food first, he ate the nutritional paste slowly, just enough to communicate.
Li Xiaoguang admired
"Chen Chong, you learn really fast, unlike before when you had no foundation."
Chen Chong shook his head
"Here, not fast enough."
Several people nodded silently.
Li Xiaoguang hesitated for a moment, then asked
"Chen Chong, can I just ask you, how do you practice your breathing technique? I thought you didn't have the basics and it would be a heavy burden, but... you mastered it in one go."
Wang Li and Liu Hetao also pricked up their ears, but Wang Li muttered
"Who would tell others the secret of their own practice? How can there be such a generous person?"
But to his surprise, Chen Chong didn't even think about it, and talked about the rules he discovered, the rhythm of the breathing method, and the tips for memory and practice.
The three of them were soon so fascinated that they even forgot to eat the food in their hands.
"It turns out...it turns out there are still these doorways. I didn't find any of them."
Liu Hetao said calmly.
Wang Li also suddenly realized, and he shouted again after hearing Liu Hetao's words.
"It's weird that you found out."
Li Xiaoguang nodded repeatedly and his eyes shone.
"Awesome! I have some ideas, I should be able to get started tomorrow!"
Wang Li, who was quite happy at first, suddenly became unhappy.
"You're going to get started tomorrow... you'll know how to do it after listening to it, brag about it."
Li Xiaoguang ignored him and just said to Chen Chong sincerely.
"Chen Chong, thank you. I didn't expect you to explain it in such detail. It's true that most people don't share their secrets. If Coach Yu hadn't said that breathing techniques should be mastered as soon as possible, I wouldn't want to be rude, but I didn't expect you to be like this!"
He gave a thumbs up.
Liu Hetao also nodded repeatedly
"Chen Chong is a good person."
"This is a good person..."
Wang Li clicked his tongue, but he just whispered and said nothing more.
Chen Chong shouted
"It's not that exaggerated. It's just that we came together and we should be in the same boat. You just don't ask. I also want to tell you during practice tomorrow morning."
He and the three of them are now in the same boat, helping them is a simple matter, and also holding together to keep warm;
Furthermore, explaining to others is also a process of re-learning for oneself.
In the past, he would gain new insights in the process of lecturing students on topics. Sure enough, he clarified some details in the breathing method just now, and his understanding of the breathing method has also deepened.
Several people discussed excitedly in low voices. In addition to breathing methods, they also talked about boxing exercises, which Li Xiaoguang knew better.
"Although Coach Yu said that breathing is the foundation, without the targeted training of boxing gymnastics, it will be very slow to temper the body by breathing alone. Moreover, without the fighting style of boxing gymnastics, even if the physical fitness is improved, it will only be brute force. If breathing is the foundation of a school, boxing gymnastics is the backbone.
"Chen Chong, you are making fast progress, you can pay more attention to the boxing exercises. I had taken a trial class with a previous teacher before, and I felt that the boxing exercises were not as good as the coach's.
"Actually, the exercise method, in addition to breathing methods and supporting boxing exercises, also includes medicinal soups, ointments, medicinal baths, etc., which is a whole system. Coach Yu definitely did not teach us everything."
